SETTINGS.Title: System Settings

ResetConfirm.Title: Reset to Defaults
ResetConfirm.Content: Are you sure you want to reset all settings to their default values?

GameRules.Name: Game Rules
GameRules.Label: Configure Game Rules
GameRules.Hint: Configure variant rules and game mechanics.
GameRules.Title: Game Rules Configuration

Health.Name: Health Configuration
Health.Label: Configure Health
Health.Hint: Configure HP calculation and variant health rules.
Health.Title: Health Configuration
Health.HitDiceInstructions: Configure how hit points are calculated for each hit die type. Auto-compute will automatically calculate HP based on the rate multiplied by the hit die maximum. Maximized indicates how many levels have maximized hit dice.
Health.VariantsInstructions: Enable variant health systems for your game.

Rounding.Name: HP Rounding
Rounding.Hint: How to round fractional hit points.

Continuity.Name: HP Continuity
Continuity.Hint: How HP are calculated across levels.

PC.Name: Wounds & Vigor (PCs)
PC.Hint: Use the Wounds and Vigor variant health system for player characters.

NPC.Name: Wounds & Vigor (NPCs)
NPC.Hint: Use the Wounds and Vigor variant health system for non-player characters.

DiagonalMovement.Name: Diagonal Movement
DiagonalMovement.Hint: Configure the diagonal movement calculation rule.

ExperienceRate.Name: Experience Progression
ExperienceRate.Hint: The rate at which characters progress through experience levels.

DisableExperienceTracking.Name: Disable Experience Tracking
DisableExperienceTracking.Hint: Hide the XP bar for milestone or story-based advancement.

FractionalBaseBonuses.Name: Fractional Base Bonuses
FractionalBaseBonuses.Hint: Use the optional fractional base attack bonus and save progression rules.

BackgroundSkills.Name: Background Skills
BackgroundSkills.Hint: Enable the background skills optional ruleset.

PsionicsAreDifferent.Name: Psionics Are Different
PsionicsAreDifferent.Hint: Treat psionics as fundamentally different from magic (no spell/power interactions).

MeasureStyle.Name: Alternate Measure Style
MeasureStyle.Hint: Use alternate visual style for measuring distances.

AutosizeWeapons.Name: Autosize Weapons
AutosizeWeapons.Hint: Automatically resize weapons to match the wielder's size.

AutoScaleAttacksBab.Name: Auto-Scale Attacks
AutoScaleAttacksBab.Hint: Automatically generate iterative attacks based on BAB.

AllowNoAmmo.Name: Allow No Ammo
AllowNoAmmo.Hint: Allow ranged attacks even without ammunition.

SpellpointCostFormula.Name: Spellpoint Cost Formula
SpellpointCostFormula.Hint: Custom formula for calculating spellpoint costs (leave blank for default).

LowLightVisionMode.Name: Low-Light Vision Mode
LowLightVisionMode.Hint: Enable enhanced low-light vision handling for tokens.

Units.Name: Unit System
Units.Hint: The measurement system used for distances and weights.

PartyHud.Name: Party HUD
PartyHud.Hint: Display a party status HUD on the screen.

PartyHudTokenImage.Name: Party HUD Token Images
PartyHudTokenImage.Hint: Show token images instead of portraits in the party HUD.

CustomSkin.Name: Custom Skin
CustomSkin.Hint: Use the custom D&D 3.5e visual theme.

TransparentSidebar.Name: Transparent Sidebar
TransparentSidebar.Hint: Make the sidebar semi-transparent when using the custom theme.

AutoCollapseItemCards.Name: Auto-Collapse Item Cards
AutoCollapseItemCards.Hint: Automatically collapse item descriptions in chat cards.

ClassFeaturesInTabs.Name: Class Features in Tabs
ClassFeaturesInTabs.Hint: Display class features in multiple tabs instead of a single list.

HideSpellDescriptions.Name: Hide Spell Descriptions
HideSpellDescriptions.Hint: Hide spell descriptions in item lists to save space.

HideSpellDescriptionsIfHasAction.Name: Hide Spell Descriptions (Actionable)
HideSpellDescriptionsIfHasAction.Hint: Hide spell descriptions only if the spell has an action.

ShowFullAttackChatCard.Name: Show Full Attack Chat Card
ShowFullAttackChatCard.Hint: Display full attack details in the chat card.

RepeatAnimations.Name: Repeat Animations
RepeatAnimations.Hint: Repeat attack animations for iterative attacks.

ThreatenedShowSquares.Name: Show Threatened Squares
ThreatenedShowSquares.Hint: Highlight threatened squares on the grid.

EnforceSingleMaterial.Name: Enforce Single Material
EnforceSingleMaterial.Hint: Prevent items from having multiple standard Material effects. Broken and Masterwork subtypes are always allowed.

SharedVisionMode.Name: Shared Vision Mode
SharedVisionMode.Hint: How shared vision is determined for players.

PlayersNoDamageDetails.Name: Hide Damage Details from Players
PlayersNoDamageDetails.Hint: Hide detailed damage information from players.

PlayersNoDCDetails.Name: Hide DC Details from Players
PlayersNoDCDetails.Hint: Hide difficulty class details from players.

AllowPlayersApplyActions.Name: Allow Players to Apply Actions
AllowPlayersApplyActions.Hint: Allow players to apply damage and healing from chat cards.

PlayersShowContextNotes.Name: Show Context Notes to Players
PlayersShowContextNotes.Hint: Show context notes to players in chat.

ChangeScrollIcon.Name: Change Scroll Icon
ChangeScrollIcon.Hint: Automatically change scroll icons based on spell school.

BuyChat.Name: Buy Chat Messages
BuyChat.Hint: Show chat messages when items are purchased.

ClearInventory.Name: Clear Inventory
ClearInventory.Hint: Allow clearing all inventory items at once.

SaveAttackWindow.Name: Save Attack Window Position
SaveAttackWindow.Hint: Remember the position of the attack dialog.

SkillSettings.Label: Skill Settings
SkillSettings.Title: Skill Configuration
SkillSettings.CustomSkillsInstructions: Add custom skills to your game.
SkillSettings.Name: Name

RollConfig.Name: Roll Configuration
RollConfig.Title: Roll Configuration
RollConfig.Instructions: Configure default roll modes for different roll types.

Currency.Name: Currency Configuration
Currency.Label: Configure Currency
Currency.Hint: Configure available coinages and currency options.
Currency.Title: Currency Configuration

CurrencyConfig.Title: Currency Configuration
CurrencyConfig.Instructions: Configure which coinages are available in your world. System coinages can be enabled or disabled; custom coinages can be fully edited.
CurrencyConfig.Label: Label
CurrencyConfig.DuplicateId: A coin with that ID already exists.
CurrencyConfig.ResetIrreversible: This will remove all custom coins and restore all defaults. This action cannot be undone.

SETTINGS.MeasurementUnitsL: System of units to be used in the world

DamageReductionTypes.Name: Damage Reduction Types
DamageReductionTypes.Hint: Configure available damage reduction material types.
DamageReductionTypes.Label: Damage Reduction Types

AvailableLanguageOptions.Name: Available Language Options
AvailableLanguageOptions.Hint: Configure which languages are available in your world.
AvailableLanguageOptions.Label: Available Language Options

AllowCustomLanguages.Name: Allow players to enter custom languages?
AllowCustomLanguages.Hint: When enabled, players can type any language name. When disabled, they must choose from the available languages list.
